t: This is the site of the Globe Theatre in Southwark, close to the south bank of the Thames. The first Globe was built in 1599 by Shakespeare's own playing company, the Lord Chamberlain's Men, and Shakespeare owned a share of it. It burned down on 29 June 1613. A second Globe was built on the same site by June 1614 and stayed open until the theatres were closed in 1642. Besides Shakespeare's plays, early works by Ben Jonson, Thomas Dekker and John Fletcher were first performed here.
